The argument bounds only Re(acc)^2 = (c*fl(1/c))^2 <= 1 and ignores Im(acc)^2; the residue |acc|^2 - 1 is fl(fl(Re^2)+fl(Im^2)) - 1 and turns positive once Im(acc)^2 >= 2^-53 (|Im csd| >~ 1.06e-8 |Re csd| when Re acc = 1, ~1.5e-8 when Re acc = 1-2^-53), whereas |csd| == |Re csd| bitwise holds up to |Im csd| ~ 1.49e-8 |Re csd|. The 14,280,000-point census (fx1.py rerun: 0 positive) remains valid, but the reason is that the audit data never approach the threshold: probe fable_recheck/ratio.py gives max |Im csd|/|Re csd| = 2.41e-12 (bivariate_gaussian T=1024 pair (2,1); min |Re csd| = 7.46e-7; 0 points above 1e-10).
